dialogues.speaker: Raymond
dialogues.text: If you discover anything of concern, you can always report it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything worth visiting in Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Raymond
dialogues.text: If it's your first time here, I recommend visiting the Mondstadt Cathedral.

dialogues.speaker: Raymond
dialogues.text: If you're tired, go have some of Mondstadt's famous wine at a tavern called "Angel's Share."

dialogues.speaker: Raymond
dialogues.text: May the Anemo Archon protect you.

dialogues.speaker: Raymond
dialogues.text: We are currently experiencing abnormal weather patterns. It is dangerous outside. Citizens are advised to seek shelter.

dialogues.speaker: Raymond
dialogues.text: That dragon could return at any time. The Knights of Favonius will keep watch; everyone else is urged to find shelter immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Raymond
dialogues.text: This is an emergency. Please be assured that the Knights of Favonius' first priority is to guarantee the safety of everyone in the city.
